newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light up as buyers chase laggards.
newsitem.headline: China Light up as buyers chase laggards.

text.p: Interest in market laggards lifted shares of China Light & Power Co Ltd on Friday, brokers said, with the stock closing the morning up HK$0.40, or 1.13 percent, at an intraday high of HK$35.80.
The shares gained HK$1.50, or 4.42 percent, in the previous four trading days.
"Demand for the less interest-rate sensitive utilities stocks boosted buying," said one dealing director.
Brokers said the stock had lagged the market, which was helping it move higher, but they expected a correction above HK$36 following the recent rally. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
